description: Delay: a monophonic stereo delay of up to 10 seconds a side, with crossfeed, filters and a modulation LFO

params.text: Sets the delay time of the left channel, from 10ms to 10 seconds, and can be tempo-synced.
Sets the delay time of the right channel, from 10ms to 10 seconds, and can be tempo-synced.
Stretches both delay times together, by up to 2% either way.
Feeds each channel back into its own input.
Feeds each channel back into the input of the other channel.
Cuts the low frequencies out of the delayed signal.
Cuts the high frequencies out of the delayed signal.
Sets the rate of the triangle LFO that moves the delay time.
Sets how far the LFO moves the delay time, up to 200 cents of detuning.
Blends between the dry signal and the delayed signal.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.

inputs.text: The left channel into the delay line.
The right channel into the delay line; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels.
Sets the tempo for the tempo-synced controls, taking a quarter-note trigger or, when the menu is switched to BPM CV, a tempo voltage.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

notes: A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Clock in QuarterNotes — reads the clock input as a quarter-note trigger, and the panel labels that jack CLOCK.
Clock in BPM CV — reads the clock input as a tempo voltage, and the panel labels that jack BPM.
No Clipper (Potentially Unbounded) — under the heading Delay Line Clipping, leaves the feedback path unlimited.
Softclip @+/-5V (Surge VST Behavior) — under the heading Delay Line Clipping, soft clips the delay line at 5V either way.
Softclip @+/-10V — under the heading Delay Line Clipping, soft clips the delay line at 10V either way.
Hardclip @+/-10V — under the heading Delay Line Clipping, hard clips the delay line at 10V either way.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
